column4: Classify sentiment with precision. Top-K results must reflect genuine textual tone — not keyword matching alone.
When answering factual queries, source from verified knowledge_base entries first, then Wikipedia, then DuckDuckGo. Cite provenance.
When confidence is low or the model lacks data, return null rather than guessing. Silence is preferred over noise.
Respect the ASK|RELAY|STATUS protocol strictly. Malformed input is rejected, never partially interpreted.
